identities.name: Alric
identities.synopsis: Human fighter and member of Stonebridge's Royal Guard.
identities.description: A human Fighter that uses a Longsword and Shield

identities.name: Elara
identities.synopsis: Human wizard living in Stonebridge who secretly carries a vampiric nature.
identities.description: Human wizard that is secretly a Vampire

identities.name: Dorf
identities.synopsis: Dwarven fighter known for fighting with a two-handed battle-axe.
identities.description: A Dwarven Fighter that uses Two-Handed Battle-Axe

identities.name: Stonebridge
identities.synopsis: Fortified settlement centered on an ancient stone crossing.
identities.description: A fortified settlement built around an old stone crossing.

identities.name: Royal Guard
identities.synopsis: Crown-sworn military organization charged with protecting the realm.
identities.description: A military organization sworn to protect the crown.

identities.name: Fighter
identities.synopsis: A martial combatant trained for direct physical conflict.
identities.description: A trained martial combatant.

identities.name: Wizard
identities.synopsis: A trained arcane spell-caster.
identities.description: A trained Spell-Caster

identities.name: Human
identities.synopsis: A human ancestry or species identity.
identities.description: A human being

identities.name: Dwarf
identities.synopsis: A dwarven ancestry or species identity.
identities.description: A dwarf.

identities.name: Captain Mara Vey
identities.synopsis: Veteran officer commanding Stonebridge's Royal Guard contingent.
identities.description: A disciplined human officer who commands the Royal Guard stationed around Stonebridge.

identities.name: Bram Tallow
identities.synopsis: Owner and keeper of the Crow & Lantern Tavern.
identities.description: A broad-shouldered human innkeeper who hears more rumors than he admits.

identities.name: Sister Ysra Fen
identities.synopsis: Traveling cleric passing through Stonebridge.
identities.description: A human cleric who tends the injured and collects stories about strange events along the old roads.

identities.name: Kelren Moss
identities.synopsis: A courier with divided loyalties and dangerous contacts.
identities.description: A nervous human courier who knows hidden paths around Stonebridge and once worked for the Ashen Circle.

identities.name: Ashen Circle
identities.synopsis: Secretive occult organization operating near Stonebridge.
identities.description: A clandestine organization that meets outside Stonebridge and pursues forbidden magical knowledge.

identities.name: Stonebridge Merchants Guild
identities.synopsis: Trade organization representing Stonebridge's established merchants.
identities.description: A wealthy guild that regulates major trade agreements and caravan business in Stonebridge.

identities.name: Mira Thorn
identities.synopsis: Scout recently recruited into the Royal Guard.
identities.description: A sharp-eyed human scout who knows the roads, ravines, and abandoned paths around Stonebridge.

identities.name: Black Pike Company
identities.synopsis: Mercenary company working the roads around Stonebridge.
identities.description: A hard-edged mercenary company that sells caravan protection and muscle to whoever can afford it.

identities.name: Ironhowl
identities.synopsis: Dorf's heavy two-handed battle-axe.
identities.description: A scarred dwarven-forged battle-axe with a dark iron head and a haft wrapped in old red leather.

identities.name: Crow & Lantern Tavern
identities.synopsis: Busy Stonebridge tavern where guards, merchants, and travelers cross paths.
identities.description: A warm but noisy tavern near the center of Stonebridge, known for cheap stew, strong ale, and overheard secrets.

identities.name: North Gate
identities.synopsis: Stonebridge's guarded northern entrance.
identities.description: A fortified gate controlling the northern road into Stonebridge.

identities.name: Old Quarry
identities.synopsis: Abandoned quarry outside Stonebridge used for secret meetings.
identities.description: A long-abandoned stone quarry cut into the hills beyond Stonebridge, filled with broken ledges and hidden recesses.

identities.name: Riverside Market
identities.synopsis: Stonebridge's crowded commercial market beside the river.
identities.description: A dense market of awnings, stalls, warehouses, and caravan yards along Stonebridge's riverfront.

identities.name: Vampire
identities.synopsis: An undead or vampiric being sustained by blood.
identities.description: A supernatural blood-drinking creature with traits that distinguish it from ordinary mortals.

identities.name: Cleric
identities.synopsis: A religious spell-caster and healer.
identities.description: A practitioner of divine magic who serves a faith, ideal, or sacred calling.

identities.name: Innkeeper
identities.synopsis: A person who operates an inn or tavern.
identities.description: A proprietor responsible for lodging, food, drink, and the daily operation of an inn or tavern.

identities.name: Merchant
identities.synopsis: A person engaged in trade and commerce.
identities.description: A trader who buys, sells, or brokers goods for profit.

identities.name: Guard Captain
identities.synopsis: An officer who commands guards or soldiers.
identities.description: A military officer responsible for directing a body of guards.

identities.name: Smuggler
identities.synopsis: A person who secretly moves restricted goods or messages.
identities.description: Someone who evades lawful inspection to transport prohibited goods, people, or information.

identities.name: Scout
identities.synopsis: A skilled observer and pathfinder.
identities.description: A person trained to reconnoiter terrain, routes, threats, and movement.

identities.name: Organization
identities.synopsis: A persistent group acting under a shared identity or purpose.
identities.description: A structured group of people recognized as a continuing collective entity.

identities.name: Tavern
identities.synopsis: A public establishment serving food and drink.
identities.description: A social establishment where travelers and locals gather for meals, drink, lodging, and conversation.

identities.name: Weapon
identities.synopsis: An object intended for combat.
identities.description: An object designed or commonly used to injure, threaten, or defend during combat.

historical_occurrences.story: Alric formally joined the Royal Guard while in Stonebridge.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Captain Mara gave Alric his first patrol assignment.
historical_occurrences.story: At Stonebridge's North Gate, Captain Mara Vey assigned Alric to his first Royal Guard patrol and warned him about unusual nighttime traffic.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Dorf acquired Ironhowl from Bram Tallow.
historical_occurrences.story: Bram Tallow sold the scarred battle-axe Ironhowl to Dorf after the dwarf spent most of an evening inspecting the weapon and arguing over its price.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Elara took a room at the Crow & Lantern.
historical_occurrences.story: Elara rented a small upstairs room from Bram Tallow at the Crow & Lantern Tavern and began using it as her base while staying in Stonebridge.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Kelren secretly delivered a sealed note to Elara.
historical_occurrences.story: Kelren Moss met Elara in a quiet corner of the Crow & Lantern and slipped her a sealed note marked with gray ash before leaving without ordering a drink.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Kelren accepted work from the Ashen Circle.
historical_occurrences.story: At the Old Quarry, the Ashen Circle recruited Kelren as a courier and ordered him to watch Royal Guard movements around Stonebridge.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Alric and Mira caught Kelren carrying contraband at the North Gate.
historical_occurrences.story: Alric and Mira Thorn stopped Kelren at the North Gate and discovered concealed contraband in his satchel. Kelren escaped into the crowd before the Guard could detain him.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Mira Thorn formally joined the Royal Guard.
historical_occurrences.story: Impressed by Mira Thorn's work during the North Gate incident, Captain Mara Vey formally recruited her into Stonebridge's Royal Guard.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: The Black Pike Company blockaded the Riverside Market.
historical_occurrences.story: During a payment dispute, the Black Pike Company blocked wagon access to the Riverside Market and threatened representatives of the Stonebridge Merchants Guild.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Dorf drove Black Pike mercenaries out of the Crow & Lantern.
historical_occurrences.story: When several Black Pike mercenaries tried to intimidate Bram Tallow over unpaid protection money, Dorf threw them out of the Crow & Lantern and made his hostility toward the company clear.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Elara secretly fed on a wounded Kelren at the Old Quarry.
historical_occurrences.story: After Kelren returned to the Old Quarry wounded and alone, Elara gave in to her vampiric hunger and fed on him, leaving him alive but badly weakened.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Kelren defected from the Ashen Circle to the Royal Guard.
historical_occurrences.story: Fearing the Ashen Circle would kill him, Kelren confessed his courier work to Alric and Captain Mara Vey and agreed to cooperate with the Royal Guard.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: The Ashen Circle ambushed Kelren and Alric intervened.
historical_occurrences.story: Ashen Circle agents cornered Kelren at the Old Quarry after his defection. Alric arrived during the attack and helped Kelren escape back toward Stonebridge.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Alric escorted Sister Ysra Fen through the North Gate.
historical_occurrences.story: After receiving reports of threats along the northern road, Alric met Sister Ysra Fen at the North Gate and escorted her safely into Stonebridge.

historical_occurrences.synopsis: Alric and Dorf compared stories about the recent trouble.
historical_occurrences.story: Over ale at the Crow & Lantern, Alric told Dorf about the Old Quarry ambush while Dorf described his confrontation with the Black Pike Company.
